# meca-antorchas-bosque (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F7, Templo del Bosque), A: both ADULT at the entrance; torches lit (the played gimmick events of rooms 17, 25 and 27: the chest, the shutter, the candles).
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 12-bosque
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 221
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.ForestTemple_Room17_TBoxAppear_CandleLight \(0x3dc9dc5e\) = 1: queued within enciende..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x3dc9dc5e \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende..end
#! expect A coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.ForestTemple_Room25_CandleLight_ShutterOpen \(0xaec198f9\) = 1: queued within enciende2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0xaec198f9 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende2..end
#! expect A coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.ForestTemple_Room27_CandleLight \(0x66197039\) = 1: queued within enciende3..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x66197039 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende3..end
mark start
warp ForestTemple ForestTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark enciende
flag HavePlayedEvent.ForestTemple_Room17_TBoxAppear_CandleLight 1
wait 300
mark enciende2
flag HavePlayedEvent.ForestTemple_Room25_CandleLight_ShutterOpen 1
wait 300
mark enciende3
flag HavePlayedEvent.ForestTemple_Room27_CandleLight 1
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
